title: Simultaneous Electrical and Mechanical Stimulation to Enhance Cells' Cardiomyogenic Potential
protocol: Autoclave two tweezers, 12 platinum PTFE electrodes, and some paper towels at 121 °C for 20 min.
Sterilize 12 PDMS custom-made constructs.
Wash each construct with 5 mL of sterile distilled water using magnetic agitation at room temperature for 15 min.
Wash each construct with 5 mL of 70% ethanol using magnetic agitation at room temperature for 5 min.
Wash each construct with 5 mL of sterile distilled water using magnetic agitation at room temperature for 10 min, repeating this step five times.
Dry the constructs on sterile paper towels inside a flow cabinet overnight.
Store the dried PDMS constructs in sterile 50 mL centrifuge tubes until use.
Transfer cleaned PDMS constructs to sterile plates before cell seeding.
Expose each construct to ultraviolet light for 5 min to ensure complete sterilization.
Transfer each construct to a 35 mm cell culture plate or 6-well plate for immediate cell seeding.
Trypsinize a confluent T75 flask of cardiac ATDPCs.
Wash the T75 flask with 5 mL of 1x phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Add 1 mL of 0.05% trypsin-EDTA and incubate at 37 °C for 5 min to detach the cells.
Add 5 mL of complete medium to inactivate the trypsin-EDTA.
Collect all cells in a 15 mL tube.
Wash the flask 2x with 5 mL of PBS to collect any remaining cells.
Centrifuge at 230 x g for 5 min at 22 °C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 2 mL of complete medium.
Count the cells with the hemocytometer chamber.
Seed 200 µL of cardiac ATDPCs (2.5 x 10^5 cells/mL) into the cell pool of the 12 PDMS constructs to cover ~80% of the seeding surface.
Incubate at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Add 2 mL of prewarmed complete medium per plate after 2–4 h when cells are attached.
Incubate the constructs overnight under culture conditions (usually 37 °C and 5% CO2).
Take six constructs for electromechanical stimulation and six as nonstimulated controls.
Clean the stimulation unit with 70% ethanol.
Place the stimulation unit in the flow cabinet.
Remove 90% of the media from the culture plate.
Place PDMS constructs in the right position for magnetic attraction between fixed and mobile magnets.
Connect platinum wire to electrode connectors and PTFE part in its designated space within the PDMS construct.
Add 2.5 mL of fresh prewarmed complete medium to each construct.
Maintain sterility throughout the procedure and operate on one construct at a time.
Return all placed constructs with electrical connections back into the incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Connect the electrical and mechanical source.
Configure the stimulation program through user interfaces of the stimulator and application controlling mechanical stimulation.
Set synchronism by selecting Option 2: Edit sequence + Enter from the main menu in the display.
Use the Mode tab to select current, then press Enter.
Select 1 (mA) for Amplitude using +/- and press Enter.
For Period (T), select 1000 (ms) with +/- and press Enter.
Set the Pulse duration (Tw) to 2 ms with +/- and press Enter.
Select External by software for Trigger mode and press Enter.
Generate sequence from the main menu and press Enter.
Write 1,000 ms in the Pulse Period text control.
Write 500 ms in the ON time (Tw) text control.
Write 2,000 AU in the Excursion text control to deliver a 10% construct elongation.
Remove the old media from the culture.
Add warm media on the sides of the PDMS support, avoiding direct contact with the cell pool.
Wash the construct 2x with 3 mL of 1x PBS for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 3 mL of 0.05% trypsin-EDTA to each plate and wait for 5 min at 37 °C.
Add 2 mL of complete medium to inactivate the trypsin-EDTA.
Collect all cells in a 15 mL tube and wash the construct 2x with 3 mL of PBS to collect any remaining cells.
Centrifuge at 230 x g for 5 min at 22 °C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of PBS.
Transfer the cell solution to a 1.5 mL tube and centrifuge at 230 x g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant and store the pellet at -80 °C in 700 μL of lysis reagent.
Isolate RNA using a commercial kit, following the manufacturer's instructions.
Reverse-transcribe the isolated RNA using the kit and random hexamers.
Preamplify small RNA concentrations if necessary.
Dilute preamplified RNA 1:5 with RNase-free water before real-time RT-PCR.
Perform standard protocol for real-time RT-PCR.
Check main cardiac markers including MEF2A, GATA-4, cTnI, cTnT, α-actinin, Cx43, and SERCA2.
Isolate proteins if needed alongside RNA isolation from the same sample when quantity permits.
Place 1 cm x 1 cm of paraffin film on top of cell pool for immunostaining to minimize evaporation.
Wash construct with 3 mL PBS twice for 5 minutes each at room temperature.
Fix cells attached to the construct with 2 mL of 10% formalin for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Wash cells 3 times with 3 mL of PBS for 5 min at room temperature.
Store samples in PBS with 0.1% sodium azide at 4 °C for long-term storage.
Permeabilize cells with 3 mL of PBS + 0.5% detergent, repeating 3 times for 5–10 min each time at room temperature.
Incubate cells with 100 µL of PBS + 10% horse serum + 0.2% detergent + 1% bovine serum albumin at room temperature for 1 h to block nonspecific antibody binding.
Incubate cells with 100 µL of PBS + 10% horse serum + 0.2% detergent + 1% bovine serum albumin + primary antibody at room temperature for 1 h.
Wash cells 3 times with 3 mL of PBS at room temperature for 5 min.
Incubate cells with 100 µL of PBS + secondary antibody in the dark at room temperature for 1 h.
Wash cells 3 times with 3 mL of PBS in the dark at room temperature for 5 min.
Incubate cells with 100 µL of nuclear staining (0.1 µg/mL) in PBS in the dark at room temperature for 15 min.
Wash cells 3 times with 3 mL of PBS in the dark at room temperature for 5 min.
Store samples in 3 mL of PBS with 0.1% sodium azide at 4 °C until acquisition.
